heading: SEBI's New Vault Rules: Enhanced Security for Gold & Silver ETFs
tldr: SEBI has introduced a comprehensive framework for vault managers storing physical gold and silver bullion underlying ETFs.
These new rules mandate stricter standards for storage, security, segregation, and reconciliation of precious metals.
The framework aims to enhance investor protection by ensuring the integrity and auditability of the physical assets.
All Asset Management Companies (AMCs) offering gold and silver ETFs must now adhere to these standardised vaulting practices.
This move significantly boosts transparency and trust in digital gold and silver investments via ETFs.
caption:
Ever wondered if your digital gold is *really* safe? Good news! India's market regulator, SEBI, just made it even safer. They've introduced strict new rules for how physical gold and silver backing your ETFs are stored. This means better security, clearer checks, and more trust for your investments. Curious how?
